title: Every Nation, One Mountain
teaser: God gathers people from every nation to worship him forever, while the fate of the unrepentant remains visible as a lasting warning.

title: The Lord Comes in Fire and Sword
teaser: God’s fiery, sword-wielding judgment falls on all who rebel, sparing no one, not even Israelite idolaters hidden in sacred gardens.

title: Joy Where Shame Once Stood
teaser: God vindicates the trembling remnant and gives Zion a sudden, overflowing increase and comfort beyond all ordinary expectation.

title: No Temple Can Hold Him
teaser: God rejects hollow sacrifice offered by self-willed hearts and looks instead to the humble, contrite worshiper who trembles at his word.

title: Former Things Forgotten, All Things New
teaser: God’s new heavens and new earth bring lasting joy, restored life, secure labor, answered prayer, and peace across all creation.

title: A Blessing Kept in the Cluster
teaser: God preserves a remnant for lasting joy while those who forsake him inherit a curse, each receiving a name that fits their destiny.

title: Here I Am to a Nation That Did Not Call
teaser: God’s eager self-revelation exposes Israel’s stubborn pursuit of pagan worship and guarantees a reckoning already written before him.

title: We Are Still the Clay
teaser: Israel appeals to God’s fatherhood and creation, not its own merit, pleading that his anger not outlast the ruin of his temple.

title: Filthy Rags and a Hidden Face
teaser: Israel admits that its polluted righteousness and its silence before God, not any failure in him, are why his face has been hidden.

title: No God Like This One
teaser: Israel’s plea for a new theophany rests on what this God has always done for those who wait for him.

title: Rend the Heavens and Come Down
teaser: Confessing a wandering heart and a trampled sanctuary, Israel appeals to the one unchanging fact left to them: the Lord alone is their Father.

title: Carried Since the Days of Old
teaser: Israel recalls the compassion that saved them at the sea, the rebellion that grieved God’s Spirit, and the deliverance still worth remembering.

title: When the Throne Is Taken Away
teaser: Pride convinces us we are untouchable. God alone decides when that ends.

title: The Warrior Who Trod Alone
teaser: The Lord’s blood-stained garments testify that the same resolve which judges his enemies is the resolve that redeems his people.

title: Behold, Your Salvation Comes
teaser: The way is cleared, the Lord’s proclamation reaches the earth, and Zion receives the names that declare her holy, redeemed, and sought after.

title: Watchmen Who Will Not Rest
teaser: The Lord charges his people to unceasing prayer, backing their watch with his own sworn oath that Zion’s harvest will finally be hers.

title: Splendor for Ashes
teaser: The Lord’s resolve to see Zion vindicated, renamed, and rejoiced over will not rest until her shame becomes his delight.

title: The Voice That Never Fails
teaser: God has never once broken his word, so today’s silence isn’t a reason to doubt him.

title: The God Who Carries You
teaser: You don’t have to hold everything together. He already is.

title: The Invitation With No Fine Print
teaser: God backs up his call to turn and be saved with an oath he can never take back.

title: When You Don’t Understand What God Is Doing
teaser: God doesn’t owe us an explanation, but he still invites our trust.

title: The God Who Calls You by Name First
teaser: Sometimes God moves in your favor long before you ever notice him.

title: Already Forgiven, Already Free
teaser: Before you can fully return to God, it helps to know the debt is already paid.

title: A Gospel Received, Not Learned
teaser: Set Apart Before Birth, Revealed in Him

title: Servant of Christ, Not Pleaser of Men
teaser: A Question of Whose Approval He Sought

title: A Curse Deliberately Pronounced
teaser: Let Him Be Cursed

title: Removed to No Gospel At All
teaser: A Warning Against Deserting the Gospel

title: Grace, Peace, and a Savior Who Gave Himself
teaser: The Gospel of Christ’s Self-Giving

title: An Authority Not Received From Men
teaser: Neither his fitness for the office nor his appointment to it passed through any human mediator.

title: [COPY] Set Free to Serve Righteousness
teaser: Grace does not create moral independence, but transfers believers from slavery to sin into obedient service to God that leads to sanctification and eternal life.

title: Everlasting Light for Zion
teaser: God exchanges Zion’s poorer materials, rule, and safety for better ones, finally replacing the sun and moon with his own everlasting light.

title: From Wrath to Favor
teaser: Those who once afflicted Zion now build, serve, and honor her, so that she knows the Lord as her Savior and Redeemer.

title: The Light That Draws the Nations
teaser: God’s own glory rising over Zion becomes the light that gathers Israel’s scattered children and the wealth of the nations home.

title: The Covenant Behind the Good News
teaser: The Spirit-anointed proclamation of liberty and comfort rests on the LORD’s own pledge of everlasting faithfulness, guaranteeing the joy it promises.

title: The Arm That Acted Alone
teaser: When no one else would intervene, the Lord armed himself to judge his enemies and redeem his people, sealing it in an everlasting covenant.

title: You Don’t Have to Earn This
teaser: God poured out his Spirit on a people who had nothing to offer him, and that gift alone turned their fear into life.

title: When Confession Finally Comes
teaser: Israel stops blaming the darkness and finally names the sin that caused it, owning guilt it had only begun to feel.

title: The Hand That Was Never Short
teaser: Israel blamed heaven for its silence, but Isaiah traces the true cause to sins that severed the relationship long before any prayer was spoken.

title: The Fast God Chooses
teaser: True fasting and true Sabbath-keeping are proven not by ritual but by justice and mercy toward others.

title: Something Greater Than the Sea
teaser: God’s past deliverance at the sea becomes proof that his coming transformation of the wilderness will surpass every former rescue.

title: When God’s Silence Finally Breaks
teaser: God’s long silence was never abandonment, and when it ends, it ends in guidance, not punishment, for those who belong to him.

title: A Song the Whole World Was Made to Sing
teaser: God calls every corner of creation to sing because his victory is already certain.

title: The God Who Actually Answers
teaser: Every rival you could trust instead of God will eventually be asked to prove itself, and none of them can.

title: No Peace for the Wicked
teaser: The chapter closes with a stark contrast: while the far and the near receive God’s peace, the wicked remain as restless as a sea that cannot be still.

title: I Will Heal Him
teaser: God answers persistent waywardness not with continued contention but with healing, guidance, and a peace pronounced to both the far and the near.

title: The High and Lofty One Who Dwells With the Lowly
teaser: God’s transcendence and his nearness to the contrite are not in tension, and his real anger against unfaithfulness is bounded by his own purpose to preserve rather than destroy.

title: Prepare the Way
teaser: God commands every obstacle cleared from his people’s path, taking the initiative himself to open the way home.

title: Whom Have You Feared
teaser: Misplaced fear let God be forgotten, but his coming exposure of empty confidence stands beside a lasting promise for the one who takes refuge in him alone.

title: Climbing the Heights, Courting Foreign Kings
teaser: The same unfaithfulness that filled the valleys with idolatry climbs the mountains and crosses borders, wearying its pursuers without ever teaching them to stop

title: Sons of the Sorceress
teaser: A people who claim covenant sonship are unmasked as idolaters, their true lineage exposed by the false portion they have embraced in place of God.

title: Waiting to Be Gracious
teaser: Even after real failure, God’s grace waits for the right moment to heal what our own choices have broken.

title: The Mercy Hidden in Loss
teaser: The righteous die unnoticed by a careless world, yet their departure is itself God’s mercy, sparing them from coming calamity and granting them peace.

title: Leaders Who Would Not Watch
teaser: God exposes the willful blindness, silence, and self-indulgence of Israel’s watchmen and shepherds, leaving his flock defenseless before devouring enemies.

title: Held by the Covenant.
teaser: God answers the eunuch’s and the foreigner’s fear of exclusion with an everlasting name, joyful worship, and a house of prayer open to all peoples.

title: Ready to Meet the Coming Salvation
teaser: God’s imminent righteousness calls his people to justice, Sabbath faithfulness, and a hand kept from evil as grateful response, not payment for grace.

title: The Word That Does Not Return Empty
teaser: Just as rain and snow never fail to water the earth, God’s word never fails to accomplish what he sends it to do.

title: While He May Be Found
teaser: God’s urgent call to seek him rests on a mercy that exceeds anything human forgiveness could imagine.

title: Everlasting Mercy, Everlasting King
teaser: God seals his covenant promises in a coming Davidic figure whose witness draws nations that never knew him.

title: Come to the Waters
teaser: God freely invites everyone who thirsts to leave behind empty pursuits and find true satisfaction in him alone.

title: Joy That Reaches the Hills
teaser: God’s promised joy and peace overflow into creation itself, transforming thorn and brier into an everlasting sign of his renown.

title: The Word We Didn’t Want to Hear
teaser: Sometimes what feels like relief is really just a refusal to hear the truth.

title: No Weapon Formed Against You Shall Prosper
teaser: God alone created both the smith and the destroyer, and this complete protection is the sure heritage of the servants of the LORD.

title: A People Taught and Established in Peace
teaser: God’s own instruction produces great peace for the city’s children, and his righteousness establishes her far from all oppression and fear.

title: A City Built by God’s Own Hand
teaser: The afflicted, storm-tossed city receives God’s own pledge to adorn her foundations, gates, and walls with precious stones.

title: An Unshakable Covenant of Peace
teaser: God’s brief anger gives way to an everlasting love and covenant of peace more certain than the mountains themselves.

title: Rise from Shame to Redeemed Hope
teaser: God silences Zion’s fear and shame by revealing himself as her Maker, Husband, and Redeemer, soon to be known by the whole earth.

title: Voices in the Wilderness Called to Sing
teaser: A barren, forsaken city is commanded to prepare for children more numerous than she ever knew as a bride, because God has already declared the increase certain.

title: When the Help You Chase Can’t Help You
teaser: Sometimes the shelter we build for ourselves becomes the very thing that leaves us exposed.

title: A Portion With the Great
teaser: The Servant’s death was no tragedy but God’s own pleasing plan, securing offspring, justification for many, and the Servant’s own exaltation.

title: Struck for My People
teaser: The Servant meets unjust oppression, an unjust death, and a shameful burial with silent, willing submission, despite his complete innocence.

title: Wounded for Us
teaser: The Servant’s suffering was not punishment for his own sin but the willing bearing of ours, so that we might have peace and healing.

title: Radiant Ground
teaser: The promised Servant grows from humble, unroyal beginnings and bears a form so unremarkable that even those who received the report fail to esteem him.

title: The Plan You Can’t Hide
teaser: No secret scheme outlasts the God who sees everything and reverses everything.

title: Marred Before He Is Magnified
teaser: God announces the Servant’s exaltation before describing his suffering, so his triumph is never in doubt.

title: Undeserved Escort Out of Captivity
teaser: God calls his people to leave defilement behind, promising his own protective presence in place of anxious haste.

title: Comfort at the City of Nothing to Lose
teaser: The watching world sees God’s own salvation the moment his people believe the news that he reigns.

title: Going Through the Motions
teaser: Sometimes the most dangerous blindness is the kind we chose without noticing.

title: Providence Reclaims a People Sold for Nothing
teaser: God grounds his coming redemption of Zion not in Israel’s worth but in his own unwavering name and character.

title: When the Ground Gives Way
teaser: Sometimes what feels like collapse is actually God clearing space to rescue you.

title: Wrath Poured Out, Wrath Poured Back
teaser: The Lord who gave Jerusalem the cup of his own wrath now removes it from her hand and places it instead into the hands of those who tormented her.

title: Awake, and Answered
teaser: The Lord answers his people’s plea for renewed power at the exodus not with a repeat of raw force but with a personal word of comfort, protection, and commissioning that guarantees his promises will r

title: Providence Beyond the Withering World
teaser: The Lord grounds his people’s hope in his proven faithfulness to Abraham and his coming salvation for the nations, both certain to outlast the fading world and the fading reproach of dying men.

title: The LORD’s Wonderful Wisdom
teaser: The farmer’s purposeful work reveals that the LORD prepares, plants, and disciplines with measured care according to His perfect purpose.

title: Trust the Name Trust the Name not your self made light
teaser: The Servant’s example forces a choice on every hearer, trust the Lord’s name in the dark or trust a self-made light that ends in torment.

title: The Ear That Listens The Back That Bends
teaser: The Servant testifies that his instructed obedience and willing suffering rest on unshaken confidence that God will vindicate him.

title: Weeping Withheld, Rebellion Answered
teaser: God exposes the true cause of Israel’s exile, not his abandonment but her own iniquity, while his power to redeem remains undiminished.

title: No Certificate, No Creditor
teaser: God proves through pointed questions that no divorce or sale from his side explains Israel’s condition, while his power to save remains completely unimpaired.

title: The Only Sure Foundation
teaser: Jerusalem’s rulers trust a refuge of lies, but the Lord establishes His tested cornerstone and sweeps every false security away.

title: Kings Will Kneel, Oppressors Will Fall
teaser: God himself moves the nations to honor Zion’s returning children and personally contends with her oppressors, until all humanity knows him as Savior and Redeemer.

title: Engraved on His Hands
teaser: Zion’s charge that God has forgotten her is answered by his unforgettable love and a sworn promise of restoration too abundant to explain.

title: Light for Every Distant Shore
teaser: God pledges to vindicate his despised Servant, appointing him covenant and light so that captives are freed, exiles gathered, and all creation moved to praise.

title: Called Before Birth, Trusted After Failure
teaser: The Servant testifies that God formed and equipped him from the womb, and answers apparent failure with trust in a mission now revealed to reach the nations.

title: Leaving Babylon Singing
teaser: God commands his redeemed people to depart Babylon with joyful proclamation, promising provision as in the wilderness, yet reminds them that peace belongs only to those who are not wicked.

title: Where Peace Like a River Might Have Flowed
teaser: God sends his own messenger with open testimony, then grieves over the abundant blessing Israel lost by refusing to listen.

title: Sovereign From First to Last
teaser: The eternal Creator who alone declared Babylon’s fall now calls, brings, and prospers the agent who will accomplish it.

title: Providence Beneath the Rebuke
teaser: God exposes Israel’s hollow oaths and stubborn heart, yet restrains his own anger, refining rather than destroying, for the sake of his own name.

title: When God’s Rest Is Refused
teaser: Judah’s intoxicated leaders reject the LORD’s clear instruction and offered rest, so His Word confronts them in judgment.

title: The Fire That Consumes Her Counselors
teaser: Babylon’s sorcerers, astrologers, and every ally scatter to save themselves, leaving her with no one to deliver her.

title: Reaching from Pleasure to Ruin
teaser: Babylon’s boast of self-sufficient security collapses in a single day, exposing her wisdom as folly before the God who alone stands unrivaled.

title: Silenced and Stripped of Her Boast
teaser: Babylon’s merciless cruelty and prideful boast of endless rule bring her down to silence and darkness.

title: Queen Brought to the Dust
teaser: The Holy One of Israel summons proud Babylon down from her throne into slave labor, declaring that her coming shame is his own righteous vengeance.

title: Trust the God Who Has Already Spoken
teaser: God calls stubborn Israel to remember that he alone declares the future and accomplishes every purpose, so his promised salvation, though not yet seen, is already certain and near.

title: Bearing the Burden That Cannot Save
teaser: Babylon’s gods must be carried away as dead weight while Yahweh alone has carried his people from birth, proving there is no one else who compares to him.

title: Every Knee, Every Tongue
teaser: God’s proven truthfulness as Creator grounds his call for every nation to turn and be saved, sealed by his own unbreakable oath.

title: Nations Bow, Israel Stands
teaser: Foreign nations come humbly to acknowledge Israel’s God while idol-worshipers face shame and Israel receives an everlasting salvation that will never end in disgrace.

title: When Proud Glory Fades
teaser: The LORD judges Ephraim’s fading pride and becomes the true crown, justice, and strength of His remnant.

title: Prayer Is Part of the Mission
teaser: Believers share in gospel service by striving together in prayer for those who go, serve, suffer, and depend upon God.

title: The Potter’s Right
teaser: God silences Israel’s complaint against his sovereign choice of a foreign king, grounding his answer in his identity as the Maker of all things.

title: The King Who Did Not Know Him
teaser: God calls and equips a pagan king for Israel’s sake, so that Cyrus and all the earth will know the LORD alone is God.

title: God Names History’s Shepherd
teaser: Because the LORD alone made all things and controls history down to naming Cyrus by name, his people can trust that his word of restoration for Jerusalem and the temple will certainly be fulfilled.

title: When God Orders the Journey
teaser: Gospel-shaped plans bring mission, fellowship, generosity, and present obedience together beneath the blessing of Christ.

title: Remembered and Redeemed
teaser: Because God has already blotted out Israel’s sin and redeemed them, all creation is summoned to praise the completeness of that forgiveness.

title: Fuel and God from the Same Tree
teaser: Idols are worthless because they are nothing more than the work of human hands, made from the same wood that fuels a fire, and their worshippers are willfully blind to that plain absurdity.

title: Chosen to Testify
teaser: The LORD alone is God, and no rival can match his power to declare the future, so his people can rest secure as living witnesses to that truth.

title: Something Greater Than Sacrifice
teaser: Israel’s hollow worship wearied God, yet he freely offers to blot out their sin, leaving them to choose confession or judgment.

title: Something Greater Than the Sea
teaser: God’s past deliverance at the sea becomes proof that his coming transformation of the wilderness will surpass every former rescue.

title: You Are My Witnesses
teaser: Israel stands as living proof that Yahweh alone is God, a claim he will soon confirm again by bringing down Babylon itself.

title: Fear Not, You Are Mine
teaser: God’s people need not fear because the One who created and redeemed them has claimed them by name and promised to gather them home.

title: Providence in the Outpoured Spirit
teaser: God pours his own Spirit on his chosen and formerly fearful servant Jacob, producing flourishing offspring and open confession of belonging to him.

title: The Work Is Christ’s, Not Ours
teaser: Faithful ministry is never a monument to human ability; it is Christ working through His servants by the power of the Holy Spirit.

title: The Blind Servant Judged
teaser: Israel, God’s own servant, is exposed as willfully blind and deaf, and this failure to see and hear God’s revealed instruction is the cause of the plundering and judgment the nation has suffered.

title: The Silence Is Broken
teaser: God ends his long restraint to guide his blind people into light while those who trust in idols are put to shame.

title: A Song for the Whole Earth
teaser: The farthest reaches of creation are summoned to sing a new song because God himself goes forth as a warrior to win the victory that grounds their praise.

title: The Covenant and the Light
teaser: The Creator himself commissions his Servant as covenant and light, staking his own exclusive glory on the certainty of what he promises.

title: The Servant Who Will Not Break
teaser: God presents his chosen Servant, empowered by the Spirit, whose patient gentleness toward the weak will not fail until justice reaches the nations.

title: The Silence of Every Rival God
teaser: The idols are called to testify and cannot speak, while God alone has declared and accomplished what history now confirms.

title: Rivers In The Wilderness
teaser: God promises to answer the poor and needy with abundant provision, transforming barren ground so that all may see and know his hand at work.

title: Redeemed From Nothing To Fear
teaser: God calls Israel his chosen servant and promises that his own hand, not their strength, will silence every enemy and reason for fear.

title: The Lord of Every Rising Power
teaser: God alone raises up the conqueror who sweeps the nations, while the coastlands’ fear only drives them deeper into the futility of gods they must nail down themselves.

title: Christ Welcomed You First
teaser: The church becomes one worshiping people when believers receive one another according to the welcome they received from Christ.

title: Your Strength Was Given to Carry Someone
teaser: Christian maturity uses freedom to bear weakness, build others up, and follow the self-giving pattern of Christ.

title: Wings Like Eagles
teaser: Israel’s complaint that God has forgotten her is answered by the tireless Creator who renews strength for those who wait on him.

title: Who Can Be Compared to God
teaser: No nation, idol, or ruler can rival the God who measures creation in his hand and calls every star by name.

title: Comfort for the Weary
teaser: God commissions comfort for his disciplined people, promising that his coming glory and enduring word will outlast every fading strength.

title: Your Freedom Is Not Just About You
teaser: Christian liberty is governed by love, so believers willingly limit freedom when its use would harm another person’s faith.

title: Treasures on Display
teaser: A king freshly rescued opens his storehouses to Babylon and learns that what he shows the world is what the world will one day take.

title: The Judgment Seat Is Already Occupied
teaser: Christ alone is Lord and Judge, so believers must not condemn or despise one another over disputed matters.

title: Song Rescued From the Silence
teaser: Having stared death in the face, Hezekiah discovers that his restored life belongs to God’s forgiving love and calls for public, generational praise.

title: Mercy Beyond the Sentence
teaser: God answers Hezekiah’s desperate prayer with life, deliverance, and a sign that confirms his covenant faithfulness beyond what was asked.

title: You Can Call Him Father
teaser: In Christ, you do not stand outside God’s family—you belong to Him.

title: Judgment Comes Home
teaser: Every word the Lord spoke against Sennacherib comes to pass, proving the mocked God has the final say.

title: A Sign and a Promise
teaser: God confirms the remnant’s future and guarantees the city’s safety, grounded not in Judah’s merit but in his own name and his promise to David.

title: Pride That Answers Itself
teaser: Sennacherib’s boasts against the Holy One of Israel become the very evidence of his coming downfall.

title: Letter Before the Lord
teaser: When Assyria’s second threat arrives in writing, Hezekiah answers not with argument but with prayer grounded in who God is.

title: Turned Toward the Temple
teaser: When the enemy’s threats reach God’s own name, a burdened king takes his fear to prayer instead of to panic.

title: The Day the Wall Heard Blasphemy
teaser: Rabshakeh turns from private persuasion to public mockery, comparing the LORD to defeated gods, while Judah answers only with silence and torn clothes.

title: A Trust Rabshakeh Could Not Break
teaser: Assyria’s envoy discredits Egypt as a broken reed, then turns the same weapon on Judah’s confidence in the LORD himself.

title: Providence Beyond the Wilderness
teaser: The coming glory of the LORD turns a broken world and a broken people into the joy and holiness of his finished kingdom.

title: The Sword That Never Fails
teaser: God’s certain judgment on the nations, pictured in Edom’s ruin, guarantees his sure word to vindicate Zion’s cause.

title: The King Who Ends the Siege
teaser: The coming King’s reign scatters the terror of siege and secures Jerusalem in a lasting safety grounded in the LORD’s own presence.

title: Who May Dwell With the Fire
teaser: Terrified sinners in Zion ask who can survive God’s consuming presence, and Isaiah answers with the marks of the one who can.

title: When Negotiation Fails
teaser: Judah’s helpless mourning is met not by human diplomacy but by the LORD’s own rising to judge the destroyer and vindicate his people’s trust.

title: The Destroyer Undone
teaser: The Lord who alone stood untouched by treachery rises to reverse it, becoming Zion’s stability, salvation, and truest treasure.

title: Childlike Trust Still Needs Wisdom
teaser: Christ teaches us to receive what is good without surrendering the discernment His Word produces.

title: Perfect Peace in the Everlasting Rock
teaser: The LORD secures those who trust him and brings the proud city down to the dust.

title: Do Not Stop at the Shadow
teaser: Melchizedek prepares us to see Jesus, whose royal and eternal priesthood surpasses every earthly priestly order.

title: Providence Poured Out from on High
teaser: God’s own Spirit, not human effort, brings the justice, peace, and abundance his people could never secure for themselves.

title: Providence Withdrawn from the Complacent
teaser: The women of Jerusalem trust in false security, and God warns that coming devastation will strip that false comfort away.

title: Providence for the Blind and the Fool
teaser: A coming righteous king does not merely rule well; he restores sight, speech, and honest judgment to a people long deceived by folly.

title: The High Priest Who Fully Meets Our Need
teaser: Jesus is the holy and eternal High Priest whose finished sacrifice gives us lasting confidence before God.

title: The Fortress That Never Was
teaser: Judah trusts Egypt’s chariots while forgetting the Lord who alone can defend Zion and cast down her enemies.

title: The LORD’s Fire Against Assyria
teaser: God appears in fierce, theophanic judgment to destroy Assyria, turning Judah’s deliverance into an occasion of festival joy.

title: Grace That Waits, Light That Heals
teaser: The LORD waits to be gracious, promising to hear Judah’s cry, teach them his way, and restore them with overflowing blessing.

title: Devastation Beyond Repair
teaser: Judah silences God’s true word for smooth illusions and refuses his offered rest, making its own sudden and total collapse certain.

title: Alliance Without Asking
teaser: Judah seeks Egypt’s protection instead of the LORD’s direction, trading covenant loyalty for a shelter that will only bring shame.

title: Redeemed From Rebellion
teaser: Those who scheme in secret against the LORD, treating him as no more than clay in their hands, find their inversion overturned by a still greater reversal — one that heals, restores, and brings a rebe

title: Blind Eyes, Sealed Words
teaser: A people who chose not to see are confirmed in that choice by God himself, yet even their sealed hearts remain within reach of his undeserved grace.

title: Ariel Besieged, Ariel Delivered
teaser: The LORD himself lays siege to his own city for her hollow worship, then suddenly scatters her enemies like a dream that vanishes at waking.

title: Your Hope Is Anchored Above
teaser: Christian hope remains secure because God cannot lie and Jesus has entered His presence for us.

title: Do Not Stop at the Foundation
teaser: God’s grace calls us beyond spiritual sluggishness into fruitful maturity, diligent hope, and persevering faith.

title: The LORD’s Wonderful Wisdom
teaser: The farmer’s purposeful work reveals that the LORD prepares, plants, and disciplines with measured care according to His perfect purpose.

title: Christian Welcome Is Not a Courtroom
teaser: Believers may differ over disputed practices while still receiving one another as servants who belong to the same Lord.

title: The Only Sure Foundation
teaser: Jerusalem’s rulers trust a refuge of lies, but the Lord establishes His tested cornerstone and sweeps every false security away.

title: When God’s Rest Is Refused
teaser: Judah’s intoxicated leaders reject the LORD’s clear instruction and offered rest, so His word confronts them in judgment.

title: When Proud Glory Fades
teaser: The LORD judges Ephraim’s fading pride and becomes the true crown, justice, and strength of His remnant.

title: The LORD Gathers His People and Restores Their Worship
teaser: The LORD will gather His scattered people one by one, summon the exiles from Assyria and Egypt, and restore them to worship Him on His holy mountain in Jerusalem.

title: The LORD Disciplines Jacob and Judges the Undiscerning
teaser: The LORD disciplines Jacob in measured judgment to remove his idolatry, while those who remain spiritually undiscerning face desolation without mercy.

title: The LORD Restores His Fruitful Vineyard
teaser: The LORD guards and restores Jacob as His vineyard, bringing His people into peace and worldwide fruitfulness.

title: The LORD Slays Leviathan
teaser: No hostile power, however terrifying or seemingly unconquerable, can survive the LORD’s decisive judgment.

title: Sheltered While the LORD Judges
teaser: God calls his people to shelter while his indignation passes, for he is coming to expose hidden bloodshed and punish guilt.

title: It Is Time to Wake Up
teaser: Because Christ’s coming day is near, believers must cast off darkness and live clothed in the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: When Human Labor Cannot Save
teaser: God’s people cannot produce deliverance, but the LORD promises life and resurrection to his dead.

title: Peace Established by the LORD
teaser: The LORD grants peace, ends oppressive rule, and enlarges his people for his glory.

title: Longing for the LORD in a World That Will Not Learn
teaser: The righteous wait for God and desire his glory, while the wicked resist both his favor and approaching judgment.

title: Perfect Peace in the Everlasting Rock
teaser: The LORD secures those who trust him and brings the proud city down to the dust.

title: Rejoicing in the LORD’s Salvation
teaser: Those who wait for the LORD will rejoice when His promised salvation is revealed, while proud opposition—represented by Moab—is completely humbled beneath His sovereign hand.

title: Death Swallowed Up Forever
teaser: God’s universal reign brings abundant provision and final victory as He removes the nations’ covering, swallows up death forever, wipes away every tear, and ends His people’s disgrace.

title: The Debt You Never Finish Paying
teaser: Love remains our continuing obligation because the good of our neighbor is never completed by one act of kindness.

title: Praise to the God Who Shelters
teaser: God faithfully fulfills His ancient purposes, humbles ruthless power, and becomes a refuge for the poor and needy.

title: Judgment Gives Way to God’s Reign
teaser: The LORD judges every rebellious power and reigns from Mount Zion in surpassing glory.

title: Praise Beyond the Present Terror
teaser: God’s future remnant praises his worldwide majesty, though present treachery and approaching terror still bring deep lament.

title: The Curse upon a Defiled Earth
teaser: God judges humanity’s covenant-breaking guilt, silences its joy, and leaves only a small remnant.

title: God Is Above Every Ruler
teaser: Christian submission honors God’s ordering of public life without giving the state the allegiance that belongs to Him alone.

title: Do Not Let Evil Choose Your Response
